input.quote: Commerce One warrants that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, and the media on which the Software is distributed will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period").
input.rationale: Section 7.3 gives a real conformance warranty for the Software and MarketSite.net Service against the Documentation, with correction/replacement and a refund of prepaid fees if the breach cannot be corrected, and the disclaimer only reaches implied warranties, so the express warranty survives. However, the software conformance period is only sixty (60) days from the Effective Date and is further capped at December 31, 1999, which fails the fallback minimum of 90 days for software. We therefore target the fallback: extend the Warranty Period to ninety (90) days and delete the fixed outside date (the 90-day period also comfortably covers the 30-day services minimum for the MarketSite.net Service). The existing repair/replace and refund remedies already satisfy the remedy elements, and the "Warranty Period" definition is retained so the cross-references in Sections 7.3, 7.4 and 11.2 remain intact. Preferred extras (professional and workmanlike standard, 12-month software period, compliance with laws) are noted but not pursued, as fallback-level terms are acceptable.

proposal.summary: Extend Warranty Period to 90 days and delete the December 31, 1999 outside date
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extend the Warranty Period for the Software and MarketSite.net Service to ninety (90) days and delete the December 31, 1999 outside date, so the conformance warranty meets our 90-day fallback minimum; the existing correction/replacement and refund remedies are unchanged.

In the event any such breach of warranty can not be reasonably corrected at Commerce One's sole expense, Corio has the right to terminate this Agreement and receive a refund of all prepaid fees.
